rationale: The assistant correctly explained side-mounted condensers and the door-frame anti-condensation pipe, reassured that this is normal, and tied the alcove clearance to the manual. It gave clear stop-and-unplug criteria (smell, warm plug, too hot to touch) and recommended no parts or engineer. It asked no questions, so it did not gather the temperature, smell and plug-warmth details or the model. It also over-explained a little, e.g. the 'first day or two' running claim and 'possibly wear out sooner'. The 'almost certainly' hedge is appropriate.
